title: A Canon of the Falling Colossus
summary: A canon of tree-giants of qi that rise to a colossal height and fall in a stroke that levels all before them.

title: Treatise on the Unending Overgrowth
summary: A treatise on growth set loose without limit until vine and thorn cover everything and close over it.

title: The Canon of the Tree Beyond Seasons
summary: A canon of divine wood qi that stands outside winter and summer and gives and takes life by its own law.
